definitions.population: ages 25-34, ACS PUMS via the Census API (50 states + DC, group quarters included), SCHL >= 12 (at least grade 9), armed forces (ESR 4, 5) dropped, unemployed (ESR 3) with 15+ usual hours dropped (unemployed with <15 hours stay as home production)
definitions.home_production: not in the labor force, or employed under 15 usual hours/week (weight 1); employed 15-29 hours: weight 0.5 in home production and 0.5 in the occupation
definitions.counts: unweighted person counts with the 0.5 rule (the workbook's convention); *_pwgtp_weighted use PWGTP x the 0.5 rule
definitions.shares: over the 20 non-teaching groups (19 market occupations + home production); K-12 share is over the 20 groups plus K-12 teachers
definitions.wage_sample: employed >= 30 usual hours/week, 48+ weeks, wage+business income floor (workbook rule: ADJINC-adjusted >= $1,000; t7 rule: $1,000 in 2010 dollars via CPI-U)
definitions.hourly_wage: income / (usual hours x 49 or 51 weeks), 1999 dollars
definitions.p90_p10: unweighted within occupation x gender (the workbook's convention); PWGTP-weighted alternative given
definitions.pooled_p90_p10: cell ratios averaged with wage-sample record counts over the 19 market occupations x gender (K-12 teachers: men and women)
definitions.mean_wage: PWGTP-weighted mean of hourly wage (1999 dollars) and of its log on the wage sample; unweighted alternative given
definitions.years_schooling: HHJK highgrade from SCHL, bounded to [9, 17]; PWGTP x 0.5-rule weighted (all persons for home production)
definitions.floor_note: T7 rule = ADJINC to survey-year dollars, then CPI-U to 2010 dollars for the floor and to 1999 dollars for wages
